description: Change a Twilio subaccount's name, status, token or Debugger URL.

auth_token.description:
The subaccount's auth token. Null, empty or the masked value keeps the stored token;
a new subaccount without one gets a generated token.

debugger_url.description: Where Twilio Debugger events for this subaccount are sent; null for none.

friendly_name.description: A name for the subaccount, e.g. the customer it belongs to.

name: sendmock_twilio_subaccount_update
